plan_title: SSPLAN-719 Test Plan — Article Badges Component

results.test: Primary Article Badges Component render path
results.steps: Open target route with valid fixture/user context.
results.assertion: Expected primary content appears with correct title/value labels and no console/runtime error.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open `/hfb/:id` and `/hfb/:hfbId/pa/:paId` from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm the news status module renders counts, rows, and status labels correctly. Relevant source path: frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/IncomingNEWs.tsx:33-81.

results.test: Interaction path for Article Badges Component
results.assertion: State transition completes within 1 click/gesture and target view/data updates correctly.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open the HFB/PA detail routes from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm searching and opening article rows updates as expected. Relevant source path: frontend/src/features/entity-detail/IncomingNEWs.tsx:33-81; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/EntityList.tsx:27-55.

results.steps: Return empty dataset or no eligible rows.
results.assertion: Fallback/empty message is shown and layout remains stable (no broken placeholders).
results.evidence: The article module has a stable empty-state message (`No articles found.`) and uses a reusable list renderer for empty results (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/IncomingNEWs.tsx:33-81; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/EntityList.tsx:27-55).

results.assertion: Error state is user-visible, recoverable on retry, and does not hard-crash route.
results.evidence: Article fetch failures bubble to page-level `ErrorBanner` on the HFB/PA detail routes (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but the `IncomingNEWs` component has no component-specific error UI.

results.steps: Run representative fixture values through transform/mapping layer.
results.assertion: Scaled and raw fields retain expected precision (sales scaled where applicable, index untouched).
results.evidence: The article row renders both the merchandising tag and the article-number pill directly from source fields (`article.tag`, `article.articleNumber`) and also shows `statusLabel` text (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/IncomingNEWs.tsx:33-81).

results.steps: Feed out-of-order and duplicate-key fixture records.
results.assertion: Output order and uniqueness follow deterministic rule (documented sort/dedupe behavior).
results.evidence: The backing article schema includes badge-related fields (`tag`, `article_number`, `status_label`) in seeded data (backend/src/main/resources/data.sql:31-38), and `EntityList` preserves row identity while filtering (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/EntityList.tsx:27-55).

results.steps: Inspect generated request payload and query params for this feature path.
results.assertion: Metric/level/filters are populated exactly as expected for selected hierarchy context.
results.evidence: The plan expects article status/readiness integration via `/metrics`, but this project fetches articles from `/api/hfbs/:id/articles` and `/api/pas/:id/articles` instead (backend/src/main/java/com/ikea/sp/controller/DashboardController.java:14,29-145; frontend/src/api.ts:41-49,135-159).
results.failure_reason: Article status metrics contract absent; project uses /api articles endpoints

results.steps: Compare required FE keys against backend response schema fixture.
results.assertion: Missing or renamed required keys fail with explicit diff and actionable message.
results.evidence: No explicit schema drift guard exists for article status payloads; the FE consumes `NewArticle` fields directly without runtime validation (frontend/src/api.ts:41-49,135-159; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/IncomingNEWs.tsx:33-81).
results.failure_reason: No article status schema drift guard
